metadata.description: Executable Candidate native TP4 recipe for LibertAI's calibrated 181 GiB GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 multimodal checkpoint. Its exact four-rank topology is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration and remains installable only for a future scale canary. The pin includes calibrated per-projection input scales that prevent FP8 block-scale underflow and long-context repetition. Upstream proves the same model family at TP2, but glm-5-3-flash-nvfp4-vllm-dual has a conservative 132 GB Controller admission envelope and does not fit the present about-126.9 GB inventory; glm-5-3-flash-exl3-dflash2-vllm-dual is the current 126 GB-envelope fleet Candidate. This contract keeps Tech2Wild's stable v8 profile and excludes experimental v9 InstantTensor.
metadata.title: GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 vLLM four Sparks
